description: The European Archetype Distribution Grid Models database collects publicly available representative distribution grid models for Europe, identified through an extensive literature review and converted into one standardised data format. It was compiled by Marius Masuch and Christian Rehtanz to give researchers comparable archetype low and medium voltage grids for studies of distribution networks across countries. It includes the German Kerber networks, synthetic voltage control low voltage networks and SimBench, a Spanish medium voltage grid model, UK low voltage network models and UKGDS, general European representative distribution networks, and newly created low voltage grids for Finland and medium voltage grids for the Netherlands. Coverage is these European countries and generic European archetypes. The database is a single ZIP of about 153 MB on Zenodo (version 1.0, July 2024) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the models are archetypes from the literature or newly generated synthetic grids, not real network records, and the original sources may carry their own terms. Simulation uses are power flow and hosting capacity studies and planning of distribution grids. Related records: SimBench is included in the collection and is catalogued as data-simbench.
name: European Archetype Distribution Grid Models
